profile.headline: Senior Systems/Software Engineer at Hewlett Packard Enterprise

positions.title: System Software Engineer III - Specialist
positions.description:
- Manage all aspects of containerized code coverage solution used by multiple teams with different testing frameworks. This includes feature development, API support, and deployments. 
 - Maintain automated system recovery tooling for shared pool of storage arrays.
- Train team members on all aspects of automated recovery and code coverage.

- Granted Trade Secret in area of Coverage Compatibility

- Selected for Leadership Excellence Acceleration Program (LEAP) Spring 2025 Cohort

positions.title: Systems/Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Maintenance and Development of automated tests and libraries in Remote Copy area (C++, Python)
- Generate code coverage metrics using Bullseye, custom scripts
- Work with team to develop and maintain C# web application utilizing vue.js, vuetify framework
- Bug triage

positions.title: ConDoc Product Manager
positions.description:
Implemented Agile development practices. 
Use customer feedback to author and refine user stories. 
Participate in product marketing.

positions.title: Documentation Specialist
positions.description:
Wrote technical software documentation for several enterprise software products.
Customized phpMyFAQ for two product help sites.
Produced and edited video documentation with Camtasia.
First and second level customer support.
Wrote a suite of downloadable reports for internal time management software.
Created a manager dashboard for viewing direct report and secondary report time data.

positions.title: Listing Coordinator
positions.description:
-Manage and market real estate listings using databases such as Paragon, Zillow/Trulia,Listing Booster, and social media platforms.
-Design and distribute print marketing materials and listing presentations.
-Create market reports using data from Paragon.
-Communicate with clients regarding showing feedback and market trends.
-Pay bills and track spending.
-Fill rental vacancies.

positions.title: Data Analyst and Project Coordinator
positions.description:
-Managed the data migration from AIM database to PeerPlace database, and implemented the new system, including training, within three months.
-Administered on site and web-based technical training to assist employees in the transition to the new database
-Maintained, analyzed and presented data to support the mission and objectives of the organization.
-Compiled easy to access dashboards, presentations, and promotional pieces tailored to internal and external audiences
-Worked collaboratively with staff members to produce statistical information for mandated reporting, grant writing, and funding applications.
-Actively participated in industry conference calls, training, and meetings to pursue further development of software to support agency objectives.
-Managed two staff members dedicated to internal software support and mandated database reporting.
-Provided training in core Microsoft Suite products.
-Served as the agency mandated Privacy Officer and provided annual data privacy training.
-Implemented Skillsoft and Silverchair Learning Management Systems.
-Adopted and provided training in GoToMeeting to reduce costs of group training and individual troubleshooting in the five county region.

honors.title: Silver Star Award - "Yes We Can"
honors.issuer: Issued by Hewlett Packard Enterprise Hybrid Cloud & Octo · Apr 2025

volunteerExperiences.description: Organize and solicit raffle items for the annual Soda Pop Hop fundraiser. Served two years as PTA president
Hour of Code introduces elementary students to coding, and also connects them with the local technology community.

projects.title: CS 401 Web Design Project
projects.description:
I created a personal website in web development class.
 
Front End: JQuery, HTML, CSS (no css or javascript frameworks were allowed)
Local Development: AMPPS
Deployment: Heroku w/ClearDB 

git repo: https://github.com/melaniejones731/CS401Website.git

projects.title: Senior Project: Boise Brewing Company -  Charity Beer Pint Counter
projects.description:
Our Senior Project was to create a device to count each time a pint of the charity beer is poured at Boise Brewing Company. We used hardware components such as the Arduino M0 Feather Board, an accelerometer, and an LED Display. The programming language used was Circuit Python.

Press:
https://arbiteronline.com/senior-capstone-project-counts-on-beer/

Boise Brewing Company Website:
https://www.boisebrewing.com/
